steps.content: Two sets of documents are neatly placed on the office desk. On the left is a Sinner dispatch report received a few days ago, while on the right is the latest pathology diagnosis report.

During the street operation, the subject disguised as an artist and attracted too much unnecessary attention with her discordant playing.

Throughout the performance, the subject unconsciously released Mania, causing the M-value of the nearby crowd to rise. Despite being stopped and driven away by several onlookers, the subject remained steadfast in performing.

In the end, due to the subject's overly high-profile performance, the undercover mission failed.
Based on observations, Sinner Echo still poses a certain threat to the public. Careful arrangement of her missions is advised.

You simply couldn't understand why, having lost the influence of Lady Pearl's power, Echo's playing level can drop so much that it reaches the level of "public hazard"... until you receive another report.

The patient was diagnosed with congenital amusia.

The clinical manifestations of amusia include the inability to discern the accuracy of pitch and the quality of melody.

Patients usually have a strong desire to perform and express themselves, and are not good at discerning others' emotions in communication.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But this isn't the most difficult part...
You flip to the last page of the report, where Echo's psychological assessment results are...
The patient shows no understanding of this condition and does not believe that she has a physiological disorder.

Due to her past living environment, the patient has subconsciously formed the identity of a "musical genius" and uses it as mental support.

When proposing treatment, please word it carefully to avoid rashly breaking the patient's self-understanding. Otherwise, she could have an emotional breakdown, resulting in an irreversible situation.
You're getting a headache from thinking about how to explain to Echo her situation.
A notification sound snaps you out of your contemplation.

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content: Sinner Echo is waiting in the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Well, let's see how it goes.
You take a few deep breaths, pick up the two reports, and get up to head for the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Long time no see, Chief!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Long time no see, Echo. I called you here today because... there are some things I want to discuss with you.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Really? What a coincidence! I also have some good news!
Echo is very happy today. You can see that the smile on the girl's face is brighter than usual, perhaps something good has happened.
However, you're the "bad guy" today. You have to burst those beautiful bubbles of happiness, music and dream that wrap her inner world.
After all, if Echo's unaware of her condition, it'll only cause more serious issues for her and others.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry, Echo... I have bad news.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Bad news? How bad can it be?
Echo shakes her head nonchalantly.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Based on my years of experience of being homeless... I mean, a performer, there can't be anything worse than the past! What is it?
You hesitate for a moment, but instead of the diagnosis report, you hand her the dispatch feedback report.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have a look, it's the performance evaluation of your undercover mission.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Performance evaluation? Is it for my street performance?!
Echo cheerfully takes the report, and immediately lowers her head to read it.
As the sound of flipping paper gets faster and faster, the smile on her face becomes more and more stiff; in the end, she slaps the report on the table and asks angrily.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: What do these people mean?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Calm down, calm down...
You quickly add:

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The MBCC mission report requires detailed and objective information, they are just writing out their observations and thoughts.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: No... they aren't telling the truth!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Those people gathered around clearly because I played so well! I'm a super talented saxophonist, how could my music possibly be, what, discordant?

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: My performance can't be bad! I'm sure of it. You can't wrong me just based on this one report!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This isn't the only one. There have been many other previous reports on similar situations, I have to take it seriously.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And I have to be responsible for every Sinner in the Bureau. I'm concerned about your situation and hope to help you find a solution.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I suspected that you might have some underlying health issues... so I arranged a physical examination for you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The examination results show that your perception of pitch is indeed somewhat abnormal.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Physical examination? Could it be that one...
Echo pauses for a moment, her plump cheeks puff up even more after she realizes.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I can't believe it, Chief, how could you trick me?!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: You said that was the annual physical examination for Sinners, and you lured me with a lavish meal after the examination! You...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Cough, you seemed to enjoy the meal, so I didn't exactly lie to you, did I...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Hmph, there's nothing wrong with me!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: There's no way my music sounds bad! I don't believe you!
Echo decisively refutes you. Through the link of shackles, you feel her confidence in her "excellent" playing skills.
...Obviously, Echo doesn't take your words to heart at all. She is still indulging in her imagination, unwilling to open her eyes.
When proposing treatment, please word it carefully to avoid rashly breaking the patient's self-understanding. Otherwise, she could have an emotional breakdown, resulting in an irreversible situation.
Indirect approach won't get Echo to accept the diagnosis or cooperate with treatment. Yet, because of the suggestions on the medical report, you're not sure how to break the news to her.
"Based on observations, Sinner Echo still poses a certain threat to the public."
But if you let things slide, the Mania that Echo unconsciously brings about will only intensify. Before it gets worse, you have to come up with something to alleviate the current situation.
Seeing you fall silent, Echo seems to think you've finally admitted defeat, and she smugly continues.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Chief, let me tell you, there are still many people out there who love my music.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Just the other day, I ran into my old friend, Sally!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Oh right, you don't know who Sally is. She's an old friend from the orphanage when I was a kid, and she's now in charge there!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: She really liked my performance. She cheered for me, and also invited me to the orphanage's charity concert!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I reunited with an old friend thanks to my music, and of course, thanks to my little Kute as well!
Echo excitedly hugs her saxophone close and affectionately rubs her cheek against it.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: This is the good news I was gonna tell you! I'm going to play at the concert.
Her expression is so proud and excited, but you still have to dampen her mood.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Hey! You tricked me before, and now you're babbling on about how I'm not a good saxophone player!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I'm really upset now, boohoo... Anyway, I demand compensation!
Before you can finish your sentence, you're interrupted by Echo again.

Regardless of the occasion or urgency of the matter, and without even understanding the meaning behind your words, the young girl is focused on how she feels, and expressing those emotions without any consideration.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: (Okay, this is also one of the symptoms of amusia; she can't help it. Don't get angry at the patient, stay calm, take a deep breath...)

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Chief, you see... There's a reason I really have to go...
Echo suddenly changes her tone, her expression and tone becoming pitiful. Apart from her musical shortcomings, she really is a talented performer.

steps.speaker: He's said too much. Rust's eyes flick skyward, where a violet star drifts past the zenith—the signal from his contact.
steps.content: I once messed up an important performance at the orphanage...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: After that, no one wanted to listen to my singing, and they stopped talking to me. Until I left, no one was willing to watch my performances.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: That was the darkest, most miserable time of my life... I've always wanted to make up for that terrible performance...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: And the opportunity finally came! Sally recognized me from my performance on the street. She acknowledged me as a musician!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Maybe this is a breakthrough. I can finally redeem myself, and conquer the audience there with a perfect performance!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Please, Chief, this concert is really important to me! Please let me go!
Echo's passionate plea moves you.
However, considering Echo's special condition, you doubt there would be a normal concert that would invite a musician of her level to participate. Something's fishy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Echo, considering the physical condition we just discussed, are you sure your old friend is serious about it? At least sleep on it before you accept.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Man... I was pouring my heart out here, why are you still hesitating?
Seeing that you're not giving in, Echo doesn't get discouraged. She quickly puts on a bright and cheerful smile.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Alright, I have an idea... If words can't convince you, then I'll just move you with music!
The self-proclaimed musical genius decisively picks up the saxophone, gets into position, brings her lips to the mouthpiece, and then takes a deep breath...
It's too late.
You can't describe the sound you're hearing.
It's deafening, earth-shaking, and overwhelming... At this moment, the entire world seems to have nothing but this terrifying sound.
The discordant, eerie sound of the saxophone resonates in the enclosed space, forcefully entering your ears, hitting you right in the gut.
You feel like your soul almost got shaken out of your body by this demonic sound. The interrogation room never felt so small before, and the door so far away from your seat.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Echo... enough...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: What is it, Chief? Are you going to give me permission?

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: If you still won't agree... I'll keep playing, even if you go to sleep, I'll be playing by your bed!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I will play until you're moved by my music!
Echo seems ready to continue, you gasp and quickly shout to stop her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Alright, that's enough!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm moved, I get it now! You can go, okay?!
The music stops abruptly. Echo opens her eyes wide, looking at you eagerly.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: You promise? No lies? No backing out?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I promise. But on one condition, I have to go to the concert with you, to avoid any accidents.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Of course, no problem, I will get an invitation for you! It's a deal!
Echo jumps off her seat excitedly, and gives you a big hug. Amid her joyful cheers, you can only smile wryly.
